fields.description: Enables the synchronisation between Frappe and Pennylane. When disabled, all scheduled syncs and webhook processing are paused.
fields.label: Enable Pennylane Integration

fields.description: Your Pennylane API key. Find it in Pennylane → Settings → API Keys.
fields.label: API Token

fields.description: Pennylane API base URL. Do not change unless instructed by Pennylane support.
fields.label: API Base URL

fields.description: Your Pennylane company identifier. Retrieved automatically when the connection test succeeds.
fields.label: Company ID

fields.description: Select which Pennylane resources should be pulled into Frappe automatically.
fields.label: Resources to Synchronise

fields.description: Pull customers from Pennylane and create or update Customer records in Frappe.
fields.label: Customers

fields.description: Pull customer invoices from Pennylane and create or update Sales Invoices in Frappe.
fields.label: Customer Invoices

fields.description: Pull quotes from Pennylane and create or update Quotations in Frappe.
fields.label: Quotes

fields.description: Pull products and services from Pennylane and create or update Items in Frappe.
fields.label: Products

fields.description: Only import data created on or after this date. Used by Force Full Re-sync and by the "Position Cursors" button to fast-forward the hourly sync starting point.
fields.label: Sync Start Date

fields.description: Send an in-app alert to System Managers when a sync job fails repeatedly after automatic retries.
fields.label: Notify on Sync Failure

fields.description: When enabled, the app automatically registers a webhook subscription with Pennylane so that events (invoice created, quote created…) trigger an immediate sync instead of waiting for the next scheduled pull. Requires the site to be accessible via HTTPS.
fields.label: Enable Webhook Reception

fields.description: Select the Pennylane events this app should react to in real time.
fields.label: Subscribed Events

fields.description: Trigger an immediate sync when a customer invoice is created in Pennylane.
fields.label: Customer Invoice Created

fields.description: Trigger an immediate sync when a quote is created in Pennylane.
fields.label: Quote Created

fields.description: Receive a notification when a DMS file is created in Pennylane (no automatic sync action).
fields.label: DMS File Created

fields.description: Pennylane subscription ID. Set automatically when the webhook is registered.
fields.label: Subscription ID

fields.description: Signing secret provided by Pennylane when the subscription was created. Used to verify the authenticity of incoming webhook requests.
fields.label: Webhook Secret

fields.description: HTTPS endpoint registered with Pennylane as the webhook destination.
fields.label: Endpoint URL

fields.description: Clears the sync cursors for the selected resources and re-imports all matching records from Pennylane from scratch. Use with caution — this operation runs in the background and may take several minutes. Select the resources below then click Run Full Sync in the Actions menu.
fields.label: Force Full Re-sync

fields.description: Leave empty to import everything. Used by Force Full Re-sync (date filter only applies to invoices) and by "Position Cursors" to fast-forward all changelogs to this date.
fields.label: Start Date

fields.description: Sync logs older than this number of days are automatically deleted by the daily cleanup task. Set to 0 to disable automatic cleanup.
fields.label: Log Retention (days)

fields.description: Read-only cursors that track the last processed position in each Pennylane changelog. They advance automatically with each sync run.
fields.label: Sync Cursors
